title: Extraction of PLFA from Wood Debris
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ixmcfk6
materials: Evaporated under a stream of oxygen-free N2

steps.title: Prepare extraction solvent mixture
steps.instruction: Mix 6 mL PBS (pH 7.4), 12 mL methanol, and 6 mL chloroform to make the extraction solution.

steps.title: Extract lipids by vortexing
steps.instruction: Add the prepared extraction solution to the wood‑debris sample and vortex the mixture thoroughly.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to separatory funnel
steps.instruction: Transfer the resulting supernatant liquid into a 50 mL separatory funnel.

steps.title: Allow phase separation overnight
steps.instruction: Let the mixture stand at room temperature for overnight (≈12–16 h) to allow phase separation.

steps.title: Collect chloroform phase
steps.instruction: Collect the lower chloroform phase from the separatory funnel.

steps.title: Concentrate extract via rotary evaporation
steps.instruction: Reduce the collected chloroform phase volume using a rotary evaporator.

steps.title: Silica chromatography and discard neutral lipids
steps.instruction: Load the concentrated extract onto a silica‑acid column, elute neutral lipids with chloroform and glycolipids with acetone, and discard these fractions.

steps.title: Alkaline methanolysis of phospholipids
steps.instruction: Perform alkaline methanolysis by vortexing the remaining fraction for 30 s in a solution of 0.56 % (w/v) KOH in dried methanol, using a 1:1 toluene:methanol solvent mixture.
